discovery: Lizardfolk raiders drag a fisherman from his overturned boat at the river's edge.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

sneak_success: You creep along the reeds and count the raiders unseen before deciding how to move in.
sneak_fail: A twig snaps underfoot. The nearest lizardfolk's head snaps around, tongue flicking toward your scent.
ignore: You leave the riverbank behind. The fisherman's shouts are cut short somewhere behind you.

victim_data.dialogue: They came up out of the reeds before I even saw them - help!
thanks: Thought I was going to end up as their supper. Thank you, friend.
after: My boat's ruined, but I'm alive. That's more than I hoped for a minute ago.

aftermath.discovery: The raiders are dead. The fisherman is soaked and shaken, eyeing the wreck of his boat.

choices.label: Escort Him to Town
choices.description: Walk him back to Northfield to dry off
choices.outcome: You walk him back to Northfield, dripping the whole way. The innkeeper gets him by the fire, and he insists on paying you back what little he has.

choices.label: Help Salvage the Boat
choices.description: See what can still be recovered
choices.outcome: You help drag the boat back onto the bank. It won't float again without real repairs, but the nets and gear are saved.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: ESC also cancels - he can manage from here
choices.outcome: You leave him to his wrecked boat and continue along the river.
